source_title: Guidelines of Tax Incentives for New Investment in the Manufacturing Sector under the New Incentive Framework (NIF)
note: Offline wiki sample following WeKnora wiki page conventions. chunk_refs are illustrative stable sample IDs, not database UUIDs.

pages.title: MIDA NIF Manufacturing Guidelines 2026
pages.summary: Malaysia's 2026 NIF manufacturing guidelines define eligible applicants, tax incentive options, NIA scorecard evaluation, tiering mechanics, compliance duties, exclusions, and sustainability requirements.

pages.title: Malaysian Investment Development Authority
pages.summary: MIDA is the Malaysian authority receiving applications, issuing principle approval letters, monitoring compliance reports, and serving as the contact point for NIF manufacturing incentives.

pages.title: New Incentive Framework
pages.summary: NIF is Malaysia's 2026 phased incentive framework that uses tiered, outcome-based evaluation to attract high-growth and high-value manufacturing investments.

pages.title: National Investment Aspirations
pages.summary: NIA is one of the cornerstone national strategies guiding the NIF and the source of the scorecard pillars used to evaluate investment outcomes.

pages.title: New Industrial Master Plan 2030
pages.summary: NIMP 2030 is a Malaysian industrial policy blueprint referenced by NIF and used to identify targeted manufacturing sectors and strategic project alignment.

pages.title: Special Tax Rate
pages.summary: Special Tax Rate is a NIF incentive that reduces corporate income tax for qualifying projects for up to 15 years, subject to annual compliance.

pages.title: Investment Tax Allowance
pages.summary: Investment Tax Allowance is a capital expenditure-based NIF incentive allowing qualifying expenditure to offset statutory income within approved periods and limits.

pages.title: NIA Scorecard
pages.summary: The NIA Scorecard is the core evaluation tool for NIF manufacturing incentives, measuring project commitments against national investment outcome pillars.

pages.title: Tiering Approach
pages.summary: The tiering approach links incentive quantum to NIA Scorecard quality and annual or period-end compliance with minimum and additional conditions.

pages.title: Global Minimum Tax
pages.summary: Global Minimum Tax is Malaysia's 2025 implementation of Pillar Two rules affecting groups with annual global revenue of at least EUR 750 million.
